visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a brown sweatshirt with a graphic of an anime character, is crouching in an outdoor area surrounded by tall dry grass and green foliage. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) He holds up a cardboard box containing various emergency food supplies. He pulls out three energy bars with red, yellow, and green wrappers, showcasing them to the viewer. (3) He displays a gold-colored tin can with a label for pork risotto and then shows a small black box which is a heating kit. (4) He opens one of the energy bars and takes a bite, followed by showing packets of instant coffee and cocoa. (5) He sets up a small metal stove on a large rock, strikes a match to light a solid fuel tablet, and places a white mug with a cat graphic on it. He pours water from a clear plastic bottle into the mug. (6) He places the tin cans on the stove to heat them up. Later, he drinks from the mug and uses a fork to pull a large piece of meat from one of the cans. (7) The scene shifts to cinematic game footage showing a character in a gas mask, a giant monster, and post-apocalyptic landscapes with a yellow bus. (8) A high-energy promotional graphic appears, featuring characters from the game Once Human, release dates, and reward items like an iPhone 16 Pro Max.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear male voice begins speaking in a friendly and engaging tone, discussing a survival scenario. The background music is a steady electronic beat with a light synth melody. (2) A sharp scraping sound occurs as a match is struck, followed by the soft sound of a flame catching. The voice explains the use of the heating kit while the BGM remains constant. (3) A distinct liquid pouring sound effect is heard as water enters the mug, overlapping with the narrator's enthusiastic description of the beverages. (4) Metallic clinking and rustling sounds are audible as food tins and packets are handled. The BGM increases slightly in volume to bridge the transition to the next segment. (5) The audio transitions into high-energy cinematic music with deep bass hits and rapid synth pulses. The narrator's voice becomes more authoritative and excited, delivering a promotional pitch for a game. Whooshing sound effects and digital pings accompany the change in visuals.
